name: app-strategy-plan-slide-with-dashed-path-between-avatars
title: Strategy plan slide linking round portraits along a dashed path with quoted findings
whatItIs: A light grey slide numbered 02 with a large title. Three circular portraits sit at staggered points on a faint dashed line that bends between them; beside each, a paragraph with black key phrases and grey secondary text, followed by a name and role.
whatItMeans: Human and calm; the path suggests a conversation moving between contributors.
techniques: Connect portraits with a dashed rounded path.
Highlight key phrases in black inside grey text.
Stagger blocks left and right to zigzag down the page.
Keep names and roles small under each paragraph.

vocabulary.definition: A dotted line linking elements in sequence.
Dark words within grey text for emphasis.
Name and role below a statement.
